description: Bulk assessment API. FastAPI port 8784. POST /v1/bulk/assess body={mcps:[list of name or url strings]} -> triggers scoring for up to 20 MCPs per request. Returns {submitted:int,job_id:str}. GET /v1/bulk/status/{job_id} -> {status:pending|complete,results:[{mcp,verdict,trust_score}]}. POST /v1/bulk/import body={servers:[{name,url,description}]} -> bulk import to mcp_server_registry. GET /v1/export/csv -> streams CSV of full registry. GET /health. Daemon with uvicorn port 8784. Heartbeat.
